item.title: Impromptu GS Bird in Hand Sticky Bun Ride (24F) — Tue Jul 28, 8:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup Be Safe, Have Fun, and Ride Together Ride leader: CP Weaver Anticipated Average Pace: 14-16 mph Route: https://routes.lancasterbikeclub.net/cue/gs-bird-in-hand-sticky-bun-ride-24f/
This is a casual C level ride. The ride leader will ride at the advertised average speed. This is intended to be a group ride with a no-drop rule as the main goal. The ride leader will do his/her best to keep the group together with occasional regroupings and a sweeper may also be appointed at the start.
Helmets are mandatory. No earbuds. Please bring water and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator). To eliminate passing around a pen and paper waiver, we require LBC Club membership and Meetup RSVP below to join this ride. Being on Meetup does not mean you are a club member. item.title: Bastidas Soccer Academy Training Camp — Tue Jul 28, 9:00 AM — Manheim Central Middle School
item.description:
Established in 1999, the Bastidas Soccer Academy emphasizes the importance of basic skill and ball mastery. We are passionate about teaching you to have fun and develop a winning attitude. All boys and girls from any school or district, entering grades 3-8, are invited to attend this premier camp to kick off the fall season. Registration is $200 per player (or $190 each for a sibling group) and will include:
Camp T-shirt USSF Licensed Coaches (including “A” License coach Trajano Bastidas) and USYS ODP Coaches Camp features– league play, king of the hill, soccer dance, small sided games, stations Main focuses– first touch, passing, receiving, finishing, having fun!
Players should arrive at least 10 minutes early each day with proper attire, sneakers, cleats, shin guards, plenty of water, and a snack for the mid-point break. Questions? item.title: Longford Park and Reynold's Dog Park- route along canal — Sun Aug 2, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Walking Tails This week we will walk along the canal. The trail in this direction is dirt and gravel. We will go out about 1.5 miles and then come back the way we came, for a total of 3 miles. CLICK DIRECTLY ON THE MAP IF YOU THINK YOU ARE LOST. IT WILL BRING YOU RIGHT TO US WHERE WE MEET.
We will be meeting near the dog park, come early and let your dog play off leash in the dog park.
Start Time: We will start hiking promptly at the scheduled time.
Duration of the walk – depends on the people and dogs in the group. We frequently end up walking in smaller packs based on the comfort level of the participants. In the past this walk takes about 1 hour or so.
Please remember pooh bags and that your dog must be on a leash that is no more than 10 feet long.
Facilities: There are bathrooms at the dog park
NOTICE: By attending this event you are agreeing that YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR OWN SAFETY AT ALL TIMES. The hike leader and other members cannot be held responsible for any damages

item.title: Dillsburg Game Night - Calvary Methodist Church in the Family Center — Wed Aug 5, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Central PA Game Club Dillsburg Game Night meets every Wednesday from 6:30-9:30pm for casual tabletop games. We’ve been going strong since 2016, and most Wednesdays you’ll find about 30-40 gamers who love to learn and teach new games. It’s a great group of friendly people.
Given the timeframe, most of the games played are light to medium Euros, although many of us also love card games (including trick-taking games) and party games. We have a library of about 200 games available to play, and people typically bring their own games as well.
We also run long game days (typically every other month, usually a Saturday 2-9pm) and other special events. Join us on Facebook or Discord for more information about those.
Attendees do not often RSVP on Meetup. It may show 1 person is coming but we have 40 people every Wednesday and will cancel the event if it is not happening. Feel free to message with questions.
Cost: Free Who: All Ages (15 and under must be accompanied by an adult) When: Every

item.title: 2nd Saturday Gaming - Colonial Park United Church of Christ — Sat Aug 8, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Central PA Game Club **COVID Notice** If you are fully vaccinated, no mask is required. If not, you are required by the church to wear a face mask. If you're not vacced and not willing to wear a mask then please do not attend.
http://www.centralpagameclub.com/images/entrance.jpg
Card and board games covering a huge gamut of themes - anything from developing islands, staging cruises, casting movies, to building railroads. There are themes appealing to every audience and most games play in 45-90 minutes. Our friendly members are happy to teach. Many games are beginner-friendly and can be taught in about 10 minutes.
Adults 16 & older.
Newcomers are welcome.
Visit http://www.centralpagameclub.com for more information.
When you enter the church's parking lot, park in the back, come in through the courtyard, and look for the door in the picture above.

item.title: CANCELLED : Teen Book Talk: What the River Knows — Mon Aug 24, 6:00 PM — Manheim Township
item.description:
Book Club, Teens
For Teens ages 13-18 years of age only.Calling all teen readers! Join us for Teen Book Talk, a fun and engaging monthly book discussion group led by members of our Teen Advisory Board! Book selections are chosen by teens during advisory meetings. Interested in joining the Teen Advisory Board? Sign up through the library calendar.
